title: Reverse-engineered craft flown only with the mind

tellings.quote: you you hear other stories of the >> reverse engineering program involving like the only way to fly the craft is with your mind

plain: Michels says he has heard stories of a reverse engineering programme, a secret effort to take apart recovered non-human craft and learn how they work, in which the only way to fly the craft was with your mind. He mentions it in passing, as something he has heard, without naming who told it. If true, it would mean the craft are built to answer to thought.
